articles.title_en: Do Higher-Cost Settings Deliver Better Outcomes? Post-Acute Care Efficiency in Medicare Skilled Nursing Facilities and Home Health Agencies
articles.title_cn: 更高成本的机构能带来更好的结果吗？Medicare 专业护理机构与家庭健康机构的急性期后护理效率
articles.abstract_en: Determining the value of different post-acute care settings for clinically similar patients is important for providers and payers. This study examines the causal effect of post-acute care (PAC) setting on Medicare spending and short-term patient outcomes among beneficiaries discharged from hospitals following treatment for stroke or congestive heart failure (CHF). Using 2013–2017 Medicare claims data, we implement an instrumental variable strategy that exploits daily variation in skilled nursing facility (SNF) bed occupancy at the hospital service area level to estimate the local average treatment effect of SNF versus home health agency (HHA) care. Our findings reveal no significant differences, on average, in 30-day mortality or rehospitalization rates between SNF and HHA care among stroke and CHF patients. However, the 95% confidence intervals do not exclude clinically meaningful reductions in 30-day mortality. Meanwhile, SNF care is associated with approximately $4700 more in Medicare spending per PAC episode. The spending gap is larger in markets with more constrained SNF capacity, particularly in states with Certificate of Need regulations, rural areas, and low-income neighborhoods. However, we do not detect statistically significant differences in short-term health outcomes across these markets on average, suggesting that supply constraints may amplify the spending implications of SNF use while the relationship between PAC setting and short-term clinical outcomes remains uncertain. These findings highlight the importance of aligning PAC discharge decisions with both clinical needs and local capacity considerations, particularly under value-based payment models.
articles.abstract_cn: 确定不同急性期后护理机构对临床相似患者的价值，对提供者和支付方都很重要。本研究考察急性期后护理（PAC）机构对 Medicare 支出和短期患者结果的因果效应，样本为因卒中或充血性心力衰竭（CHF）接受治疗后出院的受益人。使用 2013-2017 Medicare 理赔数据，我们实施工具变量策略，利用医院服务区层面专业护理机构（SNF）床位占用率的每日变化，估计 SNF 相对于家庭健康机构（HHA）护理的局部平均处理效应。我们的发现显示，平均而言，在卒中和 CHF 患者中，SNF 与 HHA 护理在 30 天死亡率或再住院率方面没有显著差异。然而，95% 置信区间不能排除 30 天死亡率具有临床意义的下降。同时，SNF 护理与每个 PAC 发作约多 $4700 的 Medicare 支出相关。在 SNF 容量更受限的市场中，支出差距更大，尤其是在实施需求证明书（Certificate of Need）监管的州、农村地区和低收入社区。然而，我们未在这些市场上平均检测到短期健康结果的统计学显著差异，这表明供给约束可能放大 SNF 使用的支出影响，而 PAC 机构与短期临床结果之间的关系仍不确定。这些发现凸显了将 PAC 出院决策与临床需求和当地容量考虑相协调的重要性，尤其是在基于价值的支付模式下。

articles.title_en: Labor unions and deaths of despair: Evidence from right-to-work laws
articles.title_cn: 工会与绝望之死：来自工作权法的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the relationship between union membership and deaths of despair. Using state-level variation in the timing of the adoption of right-to-work laws as a natural experiment, I show that right-to-work laws are associated with a decline in union membership and an increase in deaths of despair. Two-way fixed-effects (TWFE) difference-in-differences (DiD) estimates suggest that the adoption of a right-to-work law is associated with a 2.6 percentage point reduction in union membership and an increase in deaths of despair mortality of 13 additional persons per 100,000, implying there are approximately 7.5 additional deaths of despair for every 1,000 workers who lose union membership. An analysis of mechanisms suggests the increase in mortality is largely driven by increased opioid usage and a concomitant increase in overdose deaths. I support the TWFE results with estimates from two alternative estimators robust to concerns about treatment effect heterogeneity and variation in treatment timing. Estimates from the Callaway and Sant’Anna (2021) estimator and the Borusyak et al. (2024) estimator support the TWFE findings: right-to-work laws reduce union membership and increase deaths of despair.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察工会会员身份与绝望之死之间的关系。利用各州在工作权法通过时间上的差异作为自然实验，我表明工作权法与工会会员率下降以及绝望之死增加相关。双向固定效应（TWFE）双重差分（DiD）估计表明，工作权法的通过伴随着工会会员率下降2.6个百分点，以及绝望之死死亡率每100,000增加13人，这意味着每1,000名失去工会会员身份的工人，大约增加7.5例绝望之死。对机制的分析表明，死亡率的上升在很大程度上由阿片类药物使用增加以及随之而来的过量用药死亡增加所驱动。我用两个替代估计量的估计结果来支持TWFE结果，这两个估计量对处理效应异质性和处理时点变化的担忧具有稳健性。Callaway和Sant'Anna（2021）估计量以及Borusyak等（2024）估计量的估计结果支持TWFE发现：工作权法降低工会会员率并增加绝望之死。

articles.title_en: Risk, time, and diet quality: Evidence from a general population survey
articles.title_cn: 风险、时间与饮食质量：来自一般人群调查的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper explores the relationships between overall diet quality and attitudes toward risk and time using a general population survey. We combine a food frequency questionnaire and a choice-based preference module to elicit individual risk and time preferences. The online questionnaire was administered to a socioeconomic panel representative of the French population. We show that risk and time preferences are associated with individual heterogeneity in key aspects of diet quality, a result that holds across a wide range of robustness checks. Using a hierarchical Bayes framework, we jointly estimate individual risk aversion and impatience parameters and show that associations hold for both model-free and structural estimates of risk and time preferences. We further show that these associations account for a substantial share of the heterogeneity in dietary outcomes beyond sociodemographic controls. Risk and time preferences contribute to both the income–diet-quality and education–diet-quality gradients, but in opposite directions, resulting in a limited net contribution to explaining socioeconomic inequalities in diet quality.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用一项一般人群调查，探讨总体饮食质量与风险态度和时间态度之间的关系。我们将食物频率问卷与基于选择的偏好模块相结合，以引出个体的风险偏好和时间偏好。该在线问卷施测于一个具有法国人口代表性的社会经济面板。我们表明，风险偏好和时间偏好与饮食质量关键方面的个体异质性相关，这一结果在广泛的稳健性检验中均成立。使用分层贝叶斯框架，我们联合估计个体风险厌恶参数和不耐烦参数，并表明这些关联对风险偏好和时间偏好的无模型估计和结构估计均成立。我们进一步表明，这些关联在人口社会经济控制变量之外解释了饮食结果异质性的相当大份额。风险偏好和时间偏好对收入—饮食质量和教育—饮食质量梯度均有贡献，但方向相反，导致其对解释饮食质量方面的社会经济不平等的净贡献有限。

articles.title_en: The rise and fall (and rise) of the Affordable Care Act: Varying impacts on coverage over time and place
articles.title_cn: 《平价医疗法案》的兴衰（与再兴）：覆盖影响随时间与地点而变化
articles.abstract_en: The Affordable Care Act (ACA) significantly expanded health insurance in the United States, but its impact has varied across time and states. We assess the law’s heterogeneous impacts over the three presidential administrations since its enactment (between 2013 and 2023), as well as across states with different levels of implementation of the law. We focus on the law's Medicaid expansion and Marketplace subsidies, including the enhanced subsidies under the American Rescue Plan of 2021 (ARP). We use national household survey data and a triple-difference design—leveraging variation by time, place, and income—to identify the coverage impacts of the key components of the law. We find that about 50% of ACA-related coverage gains between 2013 and 2023 came from Marketplace subsidies—about 40% from the original ACA subsidies and 10% from the ARP enhancements—while the remaining half were due to Medicaid, including from the "welcome mat" effect. Coverage gains differed substantially across presidential administrations, with Marketplace subsidies in particular proving more effective under Presidents Obama and Biden than under President Trump. The same subsidy amount was >1.5 times as effective in states running their own state-based Marketplaces than in states relying on the federal Marketplace, and this result persists even after accounting for states' political ideology. Our findings highlight that while the ACA’s explicit economic features drive coverage gains, their effectiveness can be substantially enhanced or hindered through federal and state implementation.
articles.abstract_cn: 《平价医疗法案》（ACA）显著扩大了美国的医疗保险覆盖，但其影响因时间和州而异。我们评估了该法律自颁布以来（在2013至2023之间）三届总统任期内的异质性影响，以及在不同法律实施水平的州之间的差异。我们聚焦于该法律的医疗补助扩展和市场补贴，包括2021年《美国救援计划》（ARP）下的增强补贴。我们使用全国家庭调查数据和三重差分设计——利用时间、地点和收入上的变异——来识别该法律关键组成部分的覆盖影响。我们发现，在2013至2023之间，ACA相关覆盖增益中约50%来自市场补贴——约40%来自原始ACA补贴，约10%来自ARP增强补贴——而其余一半来自医疗补助，包括“欢迎垫”效应。覆盖增益在不同总统任期内差异显著，市场补贴尤其在奥巴马总统和拜登总统任内比在特朗普总统任内更有效。相同的补贴金额在运行自身州级市场的州中，其有效性是依赖联邦市场的州的>1.5倍，且在考虑州的政治意识形态后这一结果依然成立。我们的发现强调，尽管ACA的明确经济特征推动了覆盖增益，但其有效性可通过联邦和州层面的实施而大幅增强或受阻。

articles.title_en: In sickness and in health insurance: Gender in household benefit plan choice
articles.title_cn: 疾病与医疗保险中：家庭福利计划选择中的性别因素
articles.abstract_en: I document that households in the United States are more likely to choose health plans offered by the husband’s employer than the wife’s. This gap may reflect gender disparities in employment status, plan quality, or an inherent gender effect. Using a novel identification strategy that holds employment status and plan quality fixed, I find that the gender effect increases the probability of selecting the husband’s plan by 6.3 percentage points.
articles.abstract_cn: 我记录到，美国家庭更可能选择丈夫雇主提供的健康计划，而非妻子雇主提供的。这一差距可能反映了就业状态、计划质量方面的性别差异，或固有的性别效应。采用一种新颖的识别策略，在保持就业状态和计划质量固定的情况下，我发现性别效应使选择丈夫计划的概率提高了6.3个百分点。

articles.title_en: Beyond targeting women: Intrahousehold contexts and the effectiveness of food vouchers
articles.title_cn: 超越以女性为对象：家庭内部情境与食品券的有效性
articles.abstract_en: Many transfer programs target women based on evidence that mothers are more likely than fathers to allocate resources toward child welfare. However, findings on gendered impacts remain mixed—likely because parental knowledge, preferences, and household decision-making roles differ across contexts. In this study, we experimentally vary the intrahousehold informational context itself through a randomized controlled trial in rural Ethiopia. Specifically, employing a factorial design, we cross-randomize two key dimensions: (1) which parent receives nutrition behavior change communication (BCC) — neither, mother only, or both; and (2) which parent receives a household food voucher — mother or father. We find that, pooled across settings in which fathers do not receive BCC, vouchers assigned to mothers generate larger improvements in child-feeding practices than vouchers assigned to fathers. The largest effects occur when mothers receive both BCC and the voucher. This maternal advantage attenuates and is no longer detectable when fathers also receive BCC. We provide suggestive evidence that when mothers have both a knowledge advantage and control over resources, they are better able to mobilize greater intrahousehold support. These findings highlight the importance of accounting for intrahousehold contexts, not just recipient gender, when designing nutrition interventions.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多转移支付项目以女性为对象，依据是母亲比父亲更可能将资源用于儿童福利的证据。然而，关于性别化影响的研究结果仍然不一——很可能是因为父母的知识、偏好和家庭决策角色因情境而异。在本研究中，我们通过埃塞俄比亚农村的一项随机对照试验，对家庭内部信息情境本身进行实验性变化。具体而言，采用析因设计，我们对两个关键维度进行交叉随机化：（1）哪位家长接受营养行为改变沟通（BCC）——双方均不接受、仅母亲接受或双方均接受；以及（2）哪位家长接受家庭食品券——母亲或父亲。我们发现，在父亲不接受BCC的情境中合并来看，分配给母亲的食品券在儿童喂养实践上产生的改善大于分配给父亲的食品券。最大的效应出现在母亲同时接受BCC和食品券时。当父亲也接受BCC时，这种母亲优势减弱且不再可检测到。我们提供了提示性证据：当母亲同时具备知识优势和对资源的控制时，她们能够更好地调动更多的家庭内部支持。这些发现凸显了在设计营养干预措施时考虑家庭内部情境而不仅仅是受助者性别的重要性。

articles.title_en: Recent minimum wage policy and its impacts on birth outcomes
articles.title_cn: 近期最低工资政策及其对出生结局的影响
articles.abstract_en: After a pause in statutory minimum wage increases during the Great Recession, several states increased their minimum wages, including increases as large as 60% over just a few years. Using a triple difference-in-differences framework and data on the universe of births from 2010 to 2019, this study investigates how recent minimum wage hikes affected birth outcomes. We first document sizeable negative impacts of minimum wage policy on the labor supply and economic well-being of females aged 16-44. We then document small adverse effects on birth outcomes, estimating that minimum wage increases led to lower birthweight, fewer normal birthweight births, and more small for gestational age births. These findings generally contrast with an earlier literature relying primarily on much smaller minimum wage increases which showed more evidence of positive impacts on birth outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 在大衰退期间法定最低工资增长暂停之后，几个州提高了最低工资，包括在短短几年内提高幅度高达60%。本研究使用三重差分框架以及2010至2019期间的全部出生数据，考察近期最低工资上涨如何影响出生结局。我们首先记录了最低工资政策对16-44岁女性的劳动供给和经济福祉的巨大负面影响。然后我们记录了其对出生结局的小幅不利影响，估计最低工资上涨导致出生体重降低、正常出生体重出生减少以及小于胎龄儿出生增加。这些发现总体上与较早的文献形成对比，后者主要依赖幅度小得多的最低工资上涨，并显示出更多对出生结局产生积极影响的证据。

articles.title_en: Place-based variation in health care: evidence from mandatory movers in the U.S. military health system
articles.title_cn: 医疗保健中的地域差异：来自美国军队医疗系统中强制迁移者的证据
articles.abstract_en: There is increasing evidence on regional variations in US Medicare health care utilization based on older patients who move. Yet moving for the elderly population is typically endogenous, and evidence is limited for younger populations. In this paper, we harness the mandatory migration of military personnel to estimate supply and demand factors in a system of care for younger enrollees in which military physicians are salaried and copayments and deductibles are negligible. Our preferred estimates imply that supply effects explain between one-half and two-thirds of overall regional variation. articles.title_en: Patient sorting and downstream spending: evidence from an information disclosure program
articles.title_cn: 患者排序与下游支出：来自一项信息披露项目的证据
articles.abstract_en: Choosing a physician who can deliver high-quality care at a reasonable cost can improve health outcomes and reduce spending on healthcare. I study a disclosure program that classifies physicians based on quality and cost. I use a regression discontinuity design and find that physicians who score higher on both quality and cost effectiveness see 38% more new patients, and that younger patients are more responsive than older patients. Evaluating claims of patients who switch physicians following physician exit, I find that middle-aged patients experience larger reductions in spending than younger patients when switching to higher-quality, lower-cost physicians.
articles.abstract_cn: 选择能够以合理成本提供高质量医疗服务的医生可以改善健康结果并减少医疗支出。我研究了一个根据质量和成本对医生进行分类的披露项目。我使用回归断点设计，发现质量和成本效益两方面得分都较高的医生会看到38%更多的新患者，并且年轻患者比年长患者反应更敏感。通过评估在医生退出后更换医生的患者的理赔数据，我发现中年患者在转向更高质量、更低成本的医生时，支出减少幅度大于年轻患者。

articles.title_en: The effect of online sales bans on e-cigarette use
articles.title_cn: 在线销售禁令对电子烟使用的影响
articles.abstract_en: Policymakers at both the state and federal levels have promoted restrictions on online sales of electronic nicotine delivery systems (ENDS) as an important tool for reducing youth vaping. This study provides the first comprehensive evaluation of statewide online ENDS sales restrictions and their effects on youth and young adult tobacco-related behaviors. Using data from four nationally representative datasets—the Monitoring the Future survey, the State and Combined Youth Risk Behavior Surveillance System surveys, the Population Assessment of Tobacco and Health study, and the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System survey—and a generalized difference-in-differences framework, we examine the effects of these policies on product acquisition, ENDS use, and related tobacco outcomes. We find that online sales restrictions substantially reduce online purchases of ENDS products, indicating that the policies affect the targeted channel of access. Some evidence suggests substitution to social sources but also a decrease in obtaining ENDS products from “other” sources such as the black market. We find no evidence that these laws reduce overall youth ENDS use, frequent use, initiation, or cigarette smoking. These null results are consistent with online purchasing accounting for a small share of youth ENDS acquisition even prior to policy adoption. Taken together, the results suggest that restricting online sales can successfully limit a specific access channel without producing large changes in overall patterns of ENDS use.
articles.abstract_cn: 州和联邦两级的政策制定者都推动了对电子尼古丁传送系统（ENDS）在线销售的限制，将其作为减少青少年电子烟使用的重要工具。本研究首次全面评估了全州范围的ENDS在线销售限制及其对青少年和年轻成年人烟草相关行为的影响。我们使用来自四个全国代表性数据集——监测未来调查、州和合并青少年风险行为监测系统调查、烟草与健康人口评估研究以及行为风险因素监测系统调查——的数据，并采用广义双重差分框架，考察这些政策对产品获取、ENDS使用及相关烟草结果的影响。我们发现，在线销售限制大幅减少了ENDS产品的在线购买，表明这些政策影响了目标获取渠道。一些证据表明存在向社交来源的替代，但也表明从“其他”来源（如黑市）获取ENDS产品的减少。我们没有发现证据表明这些法律减少了青少年ENDS的总体使用、频繁使用、开始使用或卷烟吸烟。这些零结果与以下情况一致：即使在政策采纳之前，在线购买也仅占青少年ENDS获取的一小部分。综合来看，结果表明，限制在线销售可以成功限制特定获取渠道，而不会对ENDS使用的总体模式产生大的变化。

articles.title_en: Does advertising expand the market for hospital services? Evidence from Medicare
articles.title_cn: 广告是否扩大了医院服务的市场？来自Medicare的证据
articles.abstract_en: Direct-to-consumer advertising is pervasive in US healthcare markets, but little evidence exists on the effects of advertising by hospitals, second only to drug manufacturers in medical marketing. Advertising may help facilities increase market share by stealing existing patients, expanding the market for hospital care, or both. Regardless, it has important public finance implications due to the large sums of taxpayer funds spent by federal and state governments to subsidize hospital operations and finance care through public insurance programs. This paper provides the first causal evidence on the market expansion effects of hospital advertising. To obtain causal estimates, we leverage the fact that spikes in political advertising significantly crowd out hospital advertising in the same market, motivating an instrumental variables design. Using claims data on the universe of Traditional Medicare beneficiaries, we find that advertising expands aggregate patient volume and spending on inpatient care — though to a modest degree (implied elasticities are 0.06 and 0.05, respectively). Although the overall effect of advertising on hospital outpatient care is small and imprecise, for-profit hospitals obtain higher outpatient Medicare volume and revenue.
articles.abstract_cn: 直接面向消费者的广告在美国医疗保健市场中无处不在，但关于医院广告效果的证据很少，医院在医疗营销中的支出仅次于药品制造商。广告可能通过抢夺现有患者、扩大医院护理市场或两者兼有来帮助设施增加市场份额。无论如何，由于联邦和州政府花费大量纳税人资金来补贴医院运营并通过公共保险项目为护理提供资金，它具有重要的公共财政影响。本文提供了关于医院广告市场扩张效应的首个因果证据。为了获得因果估计，我们利用政治广告的激增会显著挤出同一市场中医院广告这一事实，从而构建工具变量设计。使用覆盖Traditional Medicare全体受益人的索赔数据，我们发现广告扩大了患者总量和住院护理支出——尽管程度温和（隐含弹性分别为0.06和0.05）。尽管广告对医院门诊护理的总体效应较小且不精确，但营利性医院获得了更高的门诊Medicare量和收入。

articles.title_en: External reference pricing versus price controls under endogenous product quality
articles.title_cn: 内生产品质量下的外部参考定价与价格管制
articles.abstract_en: Motivated by the high prices of branded/patented pharmaceuticals in many parts of the world, this paper analyzes price regulations in a two-country (home and foreign) model where a single home firm serves both markets and its R&D investment determines product quality. We study two types of price regulations: direct price controls (PCs) and external reference pricing (ERP) under which the price that the firm is permitted to charge locally depends upon its price abroad. We show that although ERP undermines R&D incentives, its implementation can raise home welfare. However, home’s optimal ERP policy is too restrictive from a joint welfare perspective. Furthermore, if the foreign market is subject to a PC, home prefers ERP to a PC due to strategic considerations that come into play due to the international price linkage created by ERP.
articles.abstract_cn: 受全球许多地区品牌/专利药品高价格的驱动，本文在一个两国（本国和外国）模型中分析价格监管，其中一家本国企业服务于两个市场，其研发投资决定产品质量。我们研究两类价格监管：直接价格管制（PCs）和外部参考定价（ERP），在ERP下，企业被允许在本地收取的价格取决于其在国外的价格。我们表明，尽管ERP削弱了研发激励，但其实施可以提高本国福利。然而，从联合福利的角度看，本国的最优ERP政策过于严格。此外，如果外国市场受制于PC，由于ERP所创造的国际化价格联系而发挥作用的战略考虑，本国更偏好ERP而非PC。
